offers_products.reason: Vehicles are mostly sold on consignment; the company offers an auction marketplace rather than selling its own goods.

offers_services.reason: Provides online auction, vehicle remarketing, towing, storage and title handling services for insurers and sellers.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Individuals can register and bid on used and salvage cars and motorcycles, though many buyers are businesses.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Insurance companies sell vehicles through it, and dealers, dismantlers and exporters buy them.

recurring_revenue.reason: Insurers and repeat buyers keep consigning and buying vehicles continually, producing recurring fee revenue.

cyclical_demand.reason: Volume comes mainly from insurer total-loss vehicles from accidents, which are fairly stable, and buyers are dismantlers and rebuilders.

big_ticket.reason: Typical sale is a single used or salvage vehicle, and the fees per transaction are modest, repeated across many lots.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from the online auction platform, yard network and vehicle logistics, not mainly from staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main sellers are large insurers, plus fleet, rental and dealer consignors, who supply most of the vehicles.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates hundreds of large vehicle storage yards worldwide, needing continual land purchases and yard expansion, plus tow and handling equipment.

notes: Buyers include dealers, dismantlers, exporters and some public individuals; sellers are mainly insurers. Revenue is mostly auction service fees.
